Chronology of every recorded fact about [[launcher construct]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== Blackflame ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 1''' — A launcher construct is a container with a Striker binding in it.}}

* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|'''Ch 4''' — Lindon uses a launcher that is a crackling bar of living lightning.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|'''Ch 4''' — The launcher is a construct made from the wrist-bones of a Remnant.}}
